payout_quote: Signing up and listing your property on Hipcamp is 100% free. ... Private landowners are subject to a 15% rate and PMS-integrated parks have a 12.5% rate. The commission is automatically deducted from each booking and clearly shown on your payout statements.
steps: Sign up on Hipcamp and create a free host listing for your land (tent sites, RV sites, cabins, glamping, etc.) with photos, amenities, site rules, and your own nightly pricing.
Choose one of Hipcamp's six cancellation policies and set seasonal rates, min/max stays, and extras (firewood, meals, activities).
Accept booking requests from vetted campers; Hipcamp handles secure payment via Stripe.
Host the stay (provide access, maintain the site, enforce your rules) and receive your payout via bank deposit, with the 15% host commission deducted automatically and shown on your payout statement.
catches: Private landowners pay a 15% commission on every booking (PMS-integrated parks 12.5%; UK hosts 12.5% + VAT), plus Stripe payment processing fees - automatically deducted, no invoicing needed.

Earnings are fully variable: you set prices but income depends on location, scenery, proximity to parks/tourist areas, season, and demand; marketing claims like 'thousands of dollars each year' describe top hosts near popular destinations.

Hosting strangers on your land carries real risk: campfires, injuries, property damage, wildlife, and trespassers. The complimentary Hipcamp Insurance policy (up to $1M in the US) has exclusions - read the policy, don't assume full coverage.
You are responsible for legal compliance: zoning, permits, campground licensing, HOA/lease rules, and transient occupancy / lodging taxes in many jurisdictions.
Campers may leave messes or damage; budget time and money for site maintenance, toilets/waste disposal, and insurance deductibles.
Strong seasonality: bookings cluster in fair-weather months in most regions.
biggest_catch: Hipcamp takes a 15% commission off every private-land booking (plus processing fees) and provides no guaranteed income - earnings depend entirely on how attractive and accessible your land is, and you carry the liability and maintenance costs of hosting strangers in the outdoors.
eligibility: Must own or legally manage suitable outdoor land; may need local permits/permission to host campers; comply with zoning, campground, and tax rules. Campers are vetted through Hipcamp.
timing: Listing is free and self-serve (~30-60 min); payout after completed bookings with 15% commission deducted. First booking depends on location appeal and season and can take weeks or months.
weasel_words: US hosts earned nearly $31 million in 2021
some hosts make thousands of dollars each year
